name: automation
description: "When X, do Y" rules the owner sets in plain words: a new file in a folder, battery low, disk space low, CPU or memory high, an app starting or closing. The action is any request ISHTI can do (run like a scheduled task, result announced); "it" means the new file. Checked every 20 s; list, pause and delete rules.
route: set up an automation rule: when something happens on this PC (file appears, battery low, app opens), do something
